best_hooks: Your partner doesn't leave the gap. You both standing still does. (Tapia & Coello, top-down rope)
Standing on the service line doesn't protect you. Standing two metres back does. (Galan, net distance)
Tennis players don't struggle in padel because of the racket. They struggle because they swing too big. (Andy Murray, swing arc)
one_line_case: Fast-growing UK audience and no training app with traction, but weak star pull, a costly 4-body/wall engine and a small existing clone (@padel.geometry, 2.9k).
